lead.title: Kimi K3 drops 2.8 trillion parameters on the table — and the open-weights debate will never be the same
lead.summary: Moonshot AI didn't just release a model yesterday; it released an argument. Kimi K3 — 896 experts, a 1M-token context window, native vision, and weights sitting on Hugging Face right now — lands the same week Washington is arguing over whether models like it should exist at all. With SGLang serving it at 423 tokens/sec on day zero, the 'open means unsafe' crowd suddenly has a much harder case to make.

top_stories.title: Amodei picks a side: Anthropic was never against open weights — it's against an unguarded frontier
top_stories.summary: The Anthropic CEO finally says the quiet part clearly: no ban on open-weight models, but chip controls and anti-distillation crackdowns aimed squarely at Beijing.

top_stories.title: Hugging Face has a deepfake problem it doesn't want to own
top_stories.summary: An AI Forensics investigation found seven of nine popular image Spaces would undress a woman with a six-word prompt — and the platform's answer so far is that safety is someone else's job.

items.title: How do agents learn to plan? A new paper traces it from pre-training to post-training
items.summary: A systematic study of multi-turn long-horizon planning shows the ability isn't magic — it can be distilled on-policy from single or multiple teachers, with big gains at every stage of training.

items.title: LOCKS wants to kill the KV-cache read — and long-context inference gets cheaper if it works
items.summary: Page-local compact key summaries replace full cache reads during decoding. If the quality holds, the economics of million-token contexts (hello, Kimi K3) shift meaningfully.

items.title: The tokenizer tax is real, and Indian languages are paying it
items.summary: English-centric subword tokenizers systematically overcharge non-English languages in tokens, latency, and cost. This paper finally puts hard numbers on a problem the industry prefers to wave away.

items.title: Nvidia, Hugging Face, Nous Research and LMSYS form an Open Secure AI Alliance
items.summary: The pitch: AI security gets better through open models and shared vulnerability research, not behind closed doors. Notably timed — it's the industry's collective rebuttal to the lock-it-down camp.

items.title: Kdeps: a CLI coding agent that runs entirely on open-weight models
items.summary: An open alternative to Claude Code and Codex that keeps your stack proprietary-free. Early, but pointing at where the open ecosystem wants to go.

items.title: Taiwan detains an Nvidia employee as the China chip-smuggling probe reaches the chipmaker itself
items.summary: First time the investigation touches Nvidia directly, alongside a $2.5B diversion scheme that already snared Super Micro executives. The export-control era just got personal.

items.title: Enigma raises $71M to make controlling a robot as easy as adjusting the volume
items.summary: Index Ventures and Ribbit Capital co-lead a bet that the missing layer in robotics isn't hardware — it's an intelligence interface anyone can use.

items.title: GENE.01: an Italian humanoid with smart skin and peer-reviewed ergonomics
items.summary: Generative Bionics, born from automotive manufacturing DNA and backed by Nature-published research, unveils a biomimetic platform aimed at labs and industry alike.
